summary: Monday 2026-11-09 picks, made Saturday from Friday's closes with no pre-market data yet. The Nasdaq is in a correction after Thursday's 5.5% AI selloff. Friday's bounce (S&P +0.3%, Nasdaq +1.1%) after a strong jobs report favors chip and earnings-beat longs, but Tuesday's CPI may keep Monday choppy. Fade the post-earnings losers.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Up 11% Friday on twice its usual volume after a record quarter and a $17B Q4 guide; chips are leading the rebound.

picks.name: Airbnb
picks.reason: Up 11.7% Friday after beating Q3, its fastest revenue growth in 3 years and a $12B buyback; a break of Friday's high puts the $193.45 52-week high in play.

picks.name: Atlassian
picks.reason: Fell about 13% Friday on guidance for slower FY27 growth and analyst downgrades; software stocks remain under pressure.

picks.name: Axon Enterprise
picks.reason: Fell 18% to a two-year low after missing Q3 and cutting its 2026 outlook on Dedrone delays; analysts are cutting price targets.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Rebounded 3% Friday after Thursday's 9% drop; holding above $185 keeps the bounce toward the $194.80 high alive ahead of Nov 17 earnings.

picks.name: Microchip Technology
picks.reason: Fell 8-11% on a weak December-quarter guide and price-target cuts while other chips bounced, a sign of relative weakness.
